verdict.rationale: Undermind's official MCP server exposes a large share of the core UI workflow programmatically: deep literature reviews, search with filters, bulk DOI/title resolution, author lookup, parallel full-text PDF Q&A, workspace notes, folders and starring. However, the vendor's own reference says MCP is the only developer surface, with no REST API, no API reference and user-scoped OAuth only, and UI features such as alerts, team management, shared workspaces and custom tables have no documented programmatic equivalent. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, programmatic alerts/notifications, team/workspace management via API, a general REST/OpenAPI surface or service-account access, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis.
Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace.
Curate papers into a folder for long-term use.
Searches the global literature, papers already in the workspace, or a paper’s references and citations in seconds. Filters by author, journal, year, and PDF availability.
Resolve titles, DOIs, or an entire bibliography into matching papers in bulk.
Programmatic queries via API ... Batch processing for high-volume research work
